about_the_game:
Embark on an amazing space adventure with the eccentric genius — Professor Galaktionov and his voice assistant Sara!

When scientists discovered an ancient satellite with an alien crystal orbiting the Moon, they had no idea what dangers and wonders this mysterious object held. Together with the professor and Sara, you must unravel its secrets and experience incredible adventures.

Get Ready for Work:

Before he can dive into research, the professor needs to get to work – and that’s a quest in itself! Fight through the chaos of his apartment, solve hilarious puzzles, and dodge obstacles to prepare for the grand adventure.

Unravel the Crystal’s Mystery:

Harness the power of the lab and its cutting-edge tech to decode the secrets of an alien crystal. But beware: your experiments might send you hurtling through the most unexpected corners of the universe.

Escape the Robots:

Trapped in a massive automated warehouse of an alien race, you’ll need to run, hide, and outsmart an army of robot guards. Hack security systems, avoid traps, and find a way to escape before you’re locked inside this colossal warehouse forever.

Battle the Robots:

Face off in an epic showdown against a giant evil robot and its minions to prove humanity won’t go down without a fight! Your courage and resolve will be humanity’s final stand in the fight for survival!

Experience Life as a Robot:

Collect gears in a nostalgic arcade-style game that feels familiar – but don’t be fooled by its simplicity. Hidden within its cogs are secrets waiting to be uncovered.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3470 or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 or AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-3770 or AMD FX™-9590 or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
